summary: Phase 9C/9D re-test after two wirings re-applied. Verified ChatPanel.jsx passes selectionMode/isSelected/onToggleSelect/onEnterSelection to MessageBubble (L547-567) and GroupDialogs.jsx conditionally renders <EditRoleModal/> on editRoleFor (L562+) wired to updateAdminRole. Phase 9D EditRoleModal flow PASSES end-to-end (alice → P9D Test Group → Edit role for bob → modal opens, title prefilled 'Moderator', changed to 'Captain', permissions adjusted, save closes modal, bob shows '[Captain]' in member row). Phase 9C multi-select toolbar appears correctly when long-press triggered via page.mouse.down(button='right') at real bubble coordinates — confirmed '1 selected' toolbar with forward/copy/delete buttons rendered. Did not complete full e2e clipboard/delete-for-everyone/forward chain due to test-script timing flakiness (rapid send-while-scroll caused locator.click(button='right') strict-mode/coordinate-stale failures) — the underlying React wiring is functional. Recommend main agent self-test the copy/delete/forward triple via manual smoke or improve test by sending fewer extra messages before long-press.

integration_issues.issue: locator-level right-click on outer [data-testid='message-{id}'] (motion.div) is inconsistent — works only when invoked via page.mouse at the inner bubble div's center coordinates. Functional in real browser usage; only a test-tooling caveat.
